name: We Energies Port Washington Lateral
researcher_notes: No existing GEM row found for this line in the roster context. EIA pipeline projects release for August 2026, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 352, lists 'We Port Washington Lateral', We Energies Inc, completed, in service December 6, 2004, 16.5 miles, 143 MMcf/d, diameters 24 and 20 inches, intrastate. A Wisconsin Energy press release of February 28, 2001 (hosted by Power Engineering) describes a proposed 16-mile lateral from the ANR Pipeline at the Town of Jackson to the Port Washington Power Plant, filed with the Public Service Commission of Wisconsin. The 2001 date is the announcement year, used for ProposalYear. Length 16.5 mi is about 26.5 km, above the 25 km threshold. Owner spelled as EIA gives it; no exact match in the ownership gazetteer. Intrastate line, so FERC silence is expected; a Public Service Commission of Wisconsin order was not located. Route not found; no official route data checked. Tier medium: two origins (EIA and the company release) but the state regulator filing was not read. Note: the line is operating, so the concrete-step test is met by completion.
